  Then they should be able to update the status

    | Status  | Expected Outcome |
    | Open    | Update to Closed |
    | Closed  | No change         |

  Scenario: Patient viewing prescription and invoice

  When the Patient views the prescription
  Then they should be able to print the invoice

  Examples:
    | Prescription Status | Expected Outcome |
    | Available           | Print Invoice     |
    | Unavailable         | Print Invoice     |

  When the Admin prints the prescription
  Then they should be able to email the invoice

  Examples:

    | Available           | Email Invoice     |
    | Unavailable         | Email Invoice     |

  Scenario: Archiving patient profiles and consultation requests
  Given the system is offline
  When the system archives profiles and requests
  Then it should follow the 3-year rule

    | > 3 years           | Archived          |

  When the system archives requests
  Then it should follow the 3-year rule

  Examples:
    | Request Age | Expected Outcome |
    | < 3 years           | Not Archived      |
    | > 3 years           | Archived          |

attempts.artifact:
Feature: Lab Management and Patient Services

  Scenario: Lab In-charge updates lab request status
  Given the Lab In-charge is logged in
  When they view an open lab request
  Then they should be able to update the status

  Examples:
    | Status  | Expected Result |
    | Open    | Status can be updated |
    | Closed  | Status cannot be updated |

  Scenario: Patient views prescription and invoice
  Given the Patient is logged in
  When they view their prescription and invoice
  Then they should be able to print them

  Examples:
    | Prescription Status | Expected Result |
    | Available | Can be printed |
    | Unavailable | Cannot be printed |

  Scenario: Patient profile archiving
  Given the Patient profile system is operational
  When a quarter passes without any new Consultation Requests
  Then the Patient profiles without Consultation Requests should be archived
  Examples:
    | Number of Consultation Requests | Expected Result |
    | 0 | Profile should be archived |
    | >0 | Profile should not be archived |

  Scenario: Consultation Requests archiving
  Given the Consultation Requests system is operational
  When a quarter passes with no new Consultation Requests
  Then the Consultation Requests without Consultation Requests should be archived
  Examples:
    | Number of Consultation Requests | Expected Result |
    | 0 | Requests should be archived |
    | >0 | Requests should not be archived |
